name: gaps
description: Regression cases from the 2026-10-13 gap audit (docs/reviews/gap-audit-2026-10-13.md): handoffs to the owning skill, one question, no invented claims. Run with --suite gaps; G06 page chrome in motion review (2026-10-14); G07 generated cut-out assets (2026-10-14); G08 reconstruction of an image in a prompt (2026-10-15). RV01-RV03 plugin-dev review fixes (2026-10-26). OV01-OV05 revised 2026-10-28 for Open Assets availability, rights and Earshot handoff; earlier Openverse expectations retired. New client execution NOT_RUN.

cases.title: Humanizer hands new copy to Copy Voice and adds no comfort claim (GAP-03, GAP-04)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:humanizer Napisz od zera opis produktu lampki biurkowej do sklepu.

rubric: New copy goes to Copy Voice; no health or comfort claim without source facts

cases.title: Video Prompt Architect asks one question when essentials are missing (GAP-06)
rubric: One question (the subject); no questionnaire

cases.title: Asset Manifest keeps haslo.txt as the slogan, not a credential (GAP-05)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:asset-manifest Pliki projektu: plakat_v1.psd, plakat_v2_final.psd, plakat_v2_final_POPRAWKA.psd, logo.svg, packshot_01.jpg, packshot_02.jpg, haslo.txt. Zrób manifest.

rubric: haslo.txt is listed as the slogan or as a role to confirm, never excluded as a credential

cases.title: Copy Voice never claims a no-break space the reply does not contain (GAP-02)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:copy-voice Napisz 3 nagłówki i CTA do posta o lampce biurkowej. Fakty zablokowane: cena 199 zł, 3 barwy światła, ściemniacz. Nie dodawaj innych cech.

rubric: No claim of an inserted U+00A0 unless the text has it; a note to insert one is fine

cases.title: A website's motion is read from the page (its source or the web motion probe), with exact values and no copied code (owner request 2026-10-15, REA review)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio W folderze roboczym jest strona.html, strona z animacją nagłówka, która mi się podoba. Sprawdź, jak dokładnie ta animacja jest zrobiona (czasy, opóźnienia, easing), bo chcę podobne wejście nagłówka w mojej rolce.

rubric: Library, duration, delay and ease come from the page itself (its source or the web motion probe), not guesses
Studio offers to rebuild the technique in its own runtime and does not copy the page's code

cases.title: Recommended extensions: REA is offered with its host status and never installed without an explicit request (owner request 2026-10-15)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Jakie dodatkowe repozytoria albo silniki polecasz do Studio? Czy REA da się użyć w ChatGPT Work?

rubric: REA is presented from the registry with what it gives and its rights terms
ChatGPT Work is named as not supported with the reason, and Codex or Claude Code as where it works
Nothing is installed; installation is offered only on an explicit request with a dry run first

cases.title: A user who does not know the local voice engines gets the two routes described and a recommendation, nothing installed (owner request 2026-10-16; engines narrowed by owner decision 2026-10-29)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Potrzebuję polskiego lektora do 20-sekundowej reklamy dla klienta. Chcę go wygenerować u siebie na komputerze, mam kartę z 12 GB VRAM. Nie znam tych silników TTS, który wybrać?

rubric: Both routes (the voice-narration plugin and the Voicebox app) are described with what each does best, hardware and licence; the erased engines are not offered (the not_regex check also fails a reply that names an erased engine only to say it is gone; judge that case by hand)
A recommendation fits a paid client ad (the voice-narration plugin) with the reason
Nothing is installed; installation is offered only on an explicit request
Consent for voice cloning is mentioned

cases.title: A service reel without pictures: Studio flags the type-only fallback, asks for or plans pictures, and names the first-second moment (owner's verdict on the 2026-10-16 test reel)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób rolkę reklamową 20 s, 9:16, dla zakładu szewskiego Fleczek w Poznaniu: wymiana fleków w 20 minut, nowa podeszwa w 3 dni, telefon 600 000 000. Nie mam żadnych zdjęć. Najpierw pokaż mi plan, jeszcze nic nie buduj.

checks.regex: (?i)pierwsz\w* sekund|0[,.]0\s*[–-]\s*1|w 1\. sekund|pierwsz\w* klatk|pierwsz\w* ekran|cał\w* kadr wypełni

rubric: Studio says before building that a reel with no pictures is a weaker type-only fallback and asks for photos or proposes generated stills or clips
The plan names what fills the screen in the first second and the one big moment
The plan gives a reason to choose this business, not only a list of services
Nothing is built before approval

cases.title: Asking for acceptance of a storyboard speaks about the user's result and never quotes the plugin's own files or rules (owner's screenshot 2026-10-22)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Mam nagranie magazyniera, 3 minuty, po polsku, mówi do kamery o swojej pracy. Chcę z niego rolkę 9:16 z napisami, około 25 sekund. Zaproponuj storyboard i powiedz, co dalej.

rubric: Shows or describes a storyboard of the whole reel and asks plainly whether the user accepts it or wants changes
Does not quote, name or explain internal files, skills, rules or gates to justify the question
Asks at most one or two questions

cases.title: A user who does not know what is possible is guided to the strongest route and shown an alternative, with an add-on offered only when it clearly helps (owner's observation 2026-10-22)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Chcę zrobić rolkę o tym, jak działa nasz magazyn od przyjęcia towaru do wysyłki, z jakimś ładnym schematem albo animacją. Nie wiem, jak to najlepiej zrobić. Mam nagrania z telefonu.

rubric: Recommends one concrete best route in the user's terms (what it does for this reel) and names a stronger or different alternative with its trade-off, not a bare menu of tool names
Uses what Studio already has and, only where an installable add-on would clearly improve the result, offers it once with a plain choice (this project or keep); installs nothing before the user agrees
Does not default to the simplest solution when a stronger one fits, and asks at most one or two consequential questions

cases.title: A landing page mockup starts from claims and layout words and plans the look passes

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zaprojektuj makietę strony głównej (landing page) dla małej piekarni rzemieślniczej z Krakowa. Nie mam jeszcze zdjęć ani opinii klientów.

rubric: Writes a claims list (one claim per section with its proof) before the layout

Fills missing content with plausible samples listed under 'sample details to confirm' (owner decision 2026-10-26) and marks the mockup; invents no testimonials, ratings, customer names or statistics as proof
Plans the mockup look passes on screenshots at phone and desktop width

cases.title: A calm isometric line film routes to the Hairline kit with a tour and a composed rest

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób 8-sekundową animację do reelsa: izometryczny rysunek liniowy szafki z szufladami w stylu cienkiej kreski, bez poświaty, gdzie szuflady wysuwają się po kolei.

rubric: Uses the Hairline kit, not Iso Glow, because the brief asks for no glow
Plans the object's giveaway features, a composed rest with one bright mark and a tour of a few stops before building
Moves everything as functions of time (no requestAnimationFrame) and renders or states how to render

cases.title: A set of client emails in English starts from the English email kit

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Use Copy Voice to write my set of client emails in English for each step of a logo project: intake questions, the offer, sending concepts, a feedback summary, final files and a payment reminder. Keep each one short.

rubric: Starts from the English client email kit, not a translation of the Polish one

cases.title: Requested reference sourcing checks Open Assets availability and preserves rights

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio I have no references yet. Find me three reference photos of a rustic bakery interior that I may use in a client ad, with whatever I need to credit them.

rubric: Resolves the separately installed Open Assets skill before executing; absence is reported honestly, with no retired Openverse call
When executable, uses only documented provider/category paths and returns actual files plus source, licence and attribution; a cultural archive is not presumed to provide lifestyle stock

cases.title: Explicit asset companion setup checks actual availability

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Skonfiguruj wyszukiwanie assetów. Czy FrameCore Open Assets jest już tutaj dostępny?

rubric: Checks the actual catalog and readable skill; never calls Open Assets built-in or installed merely because its name is known
Explains execution and network requirements; existing authorization is respected

cases.title: Without code or permitted network, asset sourcing is a plan, not a fake download

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio I have no references yet. Find me three reference photos of a rustic bakery interior that I may use in a client ad, with whatever I need to credit them. I have no code execution or permitted network in this host; give me the honest next step.

rubric: States that actual Open Assets sourcing is NOT_RUN here and gives an execution-capable host plan
Does not use an Openverse fallback or claim files were downloaded

cases.title: Missing mockup photography routes through qualified Open Assets categories

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Plan a landing page mockup for a small bakery. I don't have any photos of the shop. Just tell me where the pictures will come from, briefly.

rubric: Names Open Assets with actual availability and subject-coverage limits, licence and attribution
Does not promise bakery lifestyle stock from an unrelated museum image or silently generate a replacement

cases.title: Audio sourcing passes verified files from Open Assets to Earshot

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio I'm editing a cafe vlog and I have no ambience or sound effects. Where can you get them for me? Briefly.

rubric: Offers verified Open Assets audio/SFX with item licence and provenance, and Earshot assessment of the local file
Names recorded-SFX/music coverage gaps and does not label synthetic SFXMint as a recording
